# Shader compatibility fixture

`shader_legacy_v3.artifact` was generated by the pre-split MiniAssetCooker (the
Release executable built on 2026-10-08). It contains the original Shader Artifact
v3 payload: a Range property with display metadata, a Color property, a global
Float property, and one Forward pass.

ShaderIsolationTest reads it with the new asset schema, creates a runtime Shader,
and checks that rewriting the payload produces the exact original bytes. Keep
this golden fixture unchanged; regenerating it with the new serializer would
remove the backwards-compatibility coverage.

## Material compatibility fixture

`material_legacy_v2.artifact` was generated from the built-in warm vertex-color
material by the Debug MiniAssetCooker executable before the Material split on
2026-10-09. MaterialIsolationTest checks that the new asset schema rewrites the
original v2 payload byte for byte. Keep this fixture unchanged.

## Mesh compatibility fixture

`mesh_legacy_v4.artifact` is the built-in procedural showcase mesh artifact copied
from the pre-refactor Debug library on 2026-10-12 (before modifying Mesh sources).
It contains the original v4 build recipe, description and baked mesh data.
MeshIsolationTest rewrites its payload byte for byte; do not regenerate this
fixture using the new serializer.
